item.title: How one of Africa’s fastest growing AI platforms was built out of Ethiopia
item.description: At 85,000 users, Gebeya is a fast growing African AI startup built out of Ethiopia. The company has ambitions to build a small language model in partnership with Cassava Technologies.

item.title: The Democratic Republic of Congo accuses MTN of illegal operations
item.description: On today's Techpoint Digest, we look at DRC accusing MTN of illegal operations, Gebeya's AI gaining 80K users in four months, and Terra raising $22M after securing $11.75M.

item.title: How Iniubong Obonguko built a global engineering career through curiosity and craftsmanship
item.description: Iniubong learned to code on phone and paper during Nigeria’s power outages, later leaving university to pursue real-world engineering. His journey from Uyo startup internship to senior roles in Europe reflects the rise of Africa’s global tech talent.

item.title: NDPC launches investigation into Temu over alleged data privacy violations
item.description: Nigeria’s NDPC has launched an investigation into eCommerce giant Temu over alleged data privacy violations.

item.title: Anthropic and Rwanda partner to tackle malaria and cervical cancer with AI
item.description: Anthropic has signed a three-year deal with Rwanda to deploy AI against malaria and cervical cancer. The partnership could signal a new wave of AI collaborations between African governments and global tech firms.

item.title: MTN Group proposes $6.2 billion buy-out of IHS Towers
item.description: MTN Group proposes a $6.2 billion buy-out of IHS Towers, which will give the telecom company 100% of IHS''s shares.

item.title: MTN’s $6.2 billion IHS acquisition to face Nigerian regulatory review
item.description: Nigeria’s communications ministry will assess MTN’s $6.2 billion plan to fully acquire IHS Towers, citing concerns over competition, infrastructure control and the broader impact on the telecom sector.
